neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1148/ryai.240215 (Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Paraphrase: purpose was to assess accuracy of AI-based volume quantification of pleural effusion change on CT using drained-fluid volume as reference standard; AI-based measurements underestimated drained volume. Segmentation-based volumetry, not classifier-score regression.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2510.03856 (AI-Assisted Pleural Effusion Volume Estimation from Contrast-Enhanced CT Images, 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "To improve PE segmentation and quantification for enhanced clinical management, we have developed and trained a semi-supervised deep learning framework on contrast-enhanced CT volumes."
Paraphrase: pleural effusion severity classified into four ordinal categories (none/small/moderate/large) across 15,620 chest radiographs; ordinal grading on CXR, not CT score-vs-volume regression.

neighbors.identifier: TotalSegmentator class_details.md (github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "run task pleural_pericard_effusion and subtract the resulting pleural effusion segmentation" - confirms the pleural-effusion task exists (asset verification, not a neighbor claim).

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2602.02560 (Auditing Sybil: Explaining Deep Lung Cancer Risk Prediction Through Generative Interventional Attributions, ICML 2026)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "By leveraging realistic 3D diffusion bridge modeling to systematically modify anatomical features, our approach isolates object-specific causal contributions to the risk score." Nodule-level counterfactual attribution; finds artifact sensitivity (ECG leads/metal) and radial bias; no airway analysis, no feature-subspace erasure. Independently re-verified by auditor (arXiv + ICML 2026 poster page).

neighbors.identifier: PMID 28886252 (Total Airway Count on CT and the Risk of COPD Progression, AJRCCM 2018; method detail PMC8225550)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "The total airway count of sub-tracheal airways was calculated by automated identification of branch points on the airway tree and summing number of branches." (quoted from PMC8225550 full text using the same TAC definition).

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1148/radiol.11110542 (Quantitative CT Assessment of Emphysema and Airways in Relation to Lung Cancer Risk, Radiology 2011)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Title/abstract: associates CT-measured airway and emphysema parameters with lung cancer risk; classical measurement-to-risk correlation, no learned model probed.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1148/ryct.210311 (Airway Detection in COPD at Low-Dose CT, Radiology: Cardiothoracic Imaging)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "low-dose CT depicted most total and peripheral airways found at standard-dose CT ... detecting 90.1% of total and 84.8% of peripheral reference airways" - feasibility support that branch count is extractable from NLST-type LDCT.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2406.06512 / PMC11230513 (Merlin: A Vision Language Foundation Model for 3D Computed Tomography)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "We employ the Latent Shift approach for counterfactual generation... We also examine 'splenomegaly' classification... the size of the spleen is reduced in the counterfactual relative to the original image, adding credence to the validity of imaging features used for classification."

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1007/s00330-025-12010-4 (Deep-learning-based prediction of significant portal hypertension with single cross-sectional non-enhanced CT, European Radiology 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "The areas of interest were the umbilical portion of the portal vein (PV), the first right branch of the PV, the confluence of the splenic vein and PV, and the maximum cross-section of the spleen... used to create four deep-learning-based models for predicting CSPH."

neighbors.identifier: PMC10591114 (CounterSynth, Medical Image Analysis 2023)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "CounterSynth is a conditional generative model of diffeomorphic deformations that induce label-driven, biologically plausible changes in volumetric brain images."

neighbors.identifier: PMID 41728282 / PMC12919146 / medRxiv 10.64898/2026.02.11.26346009 (Portal Vein Diameter on Routine Clinical CT: Establishing Normals and Disease Associations, 2026)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 20,225 CTs; mean PV diameter 12.4 mm; each 1-mm increase associated with prevalent portal hypertension (OR 1.18) and incident varices (HR 1.50 baseline), but "portal vein diameter demonstrated weak to no association with invasively measured hepatic venous pressures." Premise-relevant, independently re-verified by auditor.

neighbors.identifier: ScienceDirect S2667008923000071 (CT oesophageal hiatal surface area measurements) with PMID 26304104 (Surg Endosc 2016)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Paraphrase of abstract: CT hiatal surface area on a double-oblique plane detects hiatal hernia with ~81% sensitivity / 88% specificity at a 3.5 cm2 cutoff; signal is hiatal aperture size, not gas topology.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1148/radiol.2021210198 (Spatial Dependence of CT Emphysema via Join-Count Statistics, Radiology 2021; low-attenuation-cluster strand)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Paraphrase: low-attenuation clusters quantify the number of connected low-attenuation voxels; clustering measures correlate more strongly with diffusion capacity and visual emphysema than extent-only measures - connected-component gas topology as chest-CT biomarker, applied to parenchyma only.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2312.14223 (Fast Diffusion-Based Counterfactuals for Shortcut Removal and Generation, ECCV 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Paraphrase: diffusion-based counterfactual generation that synthetically removes or adds shortcut features using a self-optimized masking scheme to spatially limit changes; applied to 2D modalities and appearance shortcuts, not topology-defined 3D CT cues.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:1901.10244 (Explicit topological priors for deep-learning based image segmentation using persistent homology)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "Our method uses the concept of persistent homology... The topological prior knowledge consists of the sequence of desired Betti numbers of the segmentation."

neighbors.identifier: Nature Scientific Reports s41598-024-72786-1 (lung attenuation gradients supine vs standing on conventional and upright CT, 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Paraphrase: in the supine position a strong attenuation gradient toward gravitationally dependent regions is observed; gradients may reflect compliance, mechanical stress distribution, or vessel distensibility. Full text behind publisher cookie gate at fetch time.

neighbors.identifier: PMC12707796 (Opacity in ground glass: remember the gravity-dependent atelectasis, 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "GGO may be a manifestation of gravity-dependent atelectasis, resulting from a synergy of diminished alveolar volume and augmented perfusion in the dependent lung regions. This presentation is frequently observed in the posterior lung bases on CT scans..."

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2209.09844 (Frequency Dropout: Feature-Level Regularization via Randomized Filtering; shortcut-learning strand incl. arXiv:2403.06748)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "Low-level image characteristics are generally easier to pick up and thus lead to a much quicker decrease in the loss function early during training" - CNNs exploit easy frequency-band cues; generic defenses, no physics-motivated gravity ramp probe.

neighbors.identifier: PMC2713983 (Dependent Lung Opacity at Thin-Section CT: spirometrically gated evaluation of lung-volume influence)
neighbors.establishing_passage: "regional lung attenuation in dependent areas progressively increasing as vital capacity decreased (p < 0.0001)... values ranging from -856.3 to -538.1 HU in dependent areas."

neighbors.identifier: PMID 19589959 (Petersson et al., Supine and prone differences in regional lung density and pleural pressure gradients, J Appl Physiol 2009)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Title/abstract: quantifies supine/prone regional lung-density differences with constant lung shape, attributing dependent-density excess to gravity-driven mechanics. Full text 403-blocked; flagged for Stage 0 re-verification.
